summary: Iteration 3 — DT app photo-retention + camera + form-defaults enhancements. Backend: added TestUploadSizeLimit, TestCronPurgeEndpoint, TestManualPurgeRBACAndIdempotency, TestPurgeEndToEnd to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 10 new cases + existing 23 = 33/33 pytest pass in ~4.5s. Covered: uploads >500KB→400 & small PNG→200; cron /api/cron/purge-photos with no-auth→401, wrong bearer→401, correct WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET+X-Webhook-Id→200 {accepted,run_id}, duplicate webhook→{duplicate:true}; /api/maintenance/purge-photos admin+driver→403, superadmin→200 with idempotent 2nd call (inspections=0,photos=0); end-to-end: upload photo → create DT-004 inspection with photo → backdate completed_at 100 days via mongosh (fix: query by _id ObjectId not id) → superadmin purge returns ≥1/≥1, GET /inspections/{id} still returns record with results[].photos=[] and photos_purged_at set and purged_photo_count≥1 and total_items unchanged, GET /files/{path}→404, recent DT-005 inspection untouched. Frontend Playwright (fake camera stream + camera permission granted): /inspections/new + DT-002 → form-progress-text = '0/29 items flagged', all 29 item-<id>-status-OK pills have data-selected='true', 29 item-<id>-photo-add buttons rendered on every card (OK included); submit btn enabled with only KM entered; clicking KOROSI → '1/29 items flagged' and note textarea appears. Camera overlay portaled to <body> (parent=BODY, rect covers full 1920x1080 including sidebar area); capture→retake/use buttons; use → compress+upload → thumbnail with item-<id>-photo-remove rendered. Submitted inspection with 1 defect + 1 photo on OK item → detail page shows defect-table (1 row) AND all-items-table (29 rows) with photo thumbnail on OK item, no 'Show all' toggle. Purged inspection detail (6a9d5d42c98ffec88af1896b, found via API photos_purged_at!=null) shows photos-purged-notice ('Photos were removed after the 3-month retention period; the inspection record is kept.'). Fixed submit bar spans the content column on desktop (width=1664, left=256, viewport=1920) and full-width on mobile (width=390, left=0, viewport=390). Regression pass: admin approve flow works (approved with note), /recap page has matrix+summary tabs, EN/ID toggle works.
critical_code_review_comments: cron_purge_photos() only rejects when Authorization header is missing/wrong but doesn't rate-limit; a single wrong-secret attacker can log-flood. Consider IP-based backoff (like login) since this is an internet-facing webhook.

purge_old_photos() writes empty bytes via put_object() to satisfy the 'storage overwritten' requirement, but if put_object fails the loop continues and still marks db.files.is_deleted=true — the file entry is soft-deleted while storage may still hold the original bytes. Consider only setting is_deleted after put_object succeeds, or capture partial failures per file in the summary.

manual_purge_photos runs synchronously (no BackgroundTasks) unlike the cron variant, so a large purge could exceed request timeout for superadmin. Acceptable for now given small dataset, but noting for scale.

Upload size check enforces MAX_PHOTO_BYTES only after full read(); if a client streams a massive file the whole payload is still buffered in memory before rejection. FastAPI/Starlette can enforce content-length via server settings for defence in depth.

InspectionFormPage 'ready' still requires done===items.length; since all items default to OK on truck select, this is fine — but if a future refactor removes default-OK, submit will silently be gated. Consider asserting items.length>0 && km_hm filled instead once defaults are locked in.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created (and left) 2 inspections: 1 on DT-004 whose completed_at was backdated to 100 days ago and is now purged (photos_purged_at set), and 1 recent DT-005 inspection with a photo (must NOT be purged — acts as guard). One additional DT-002 inspection was created via Playwright submit-flow with 1 defect + 1 photo on an OK item; admin approved a previous pending DT-002 inspection during regression. All prior seeded masters (DT-001..005, categories, 37 items) untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inspections use MongoDB _id as ObjectId; API 'id' == str(_id). To backdate via mongosh use {_id: ObjectId('<id>')}. Camera testing needs page.context.grant_permissions(['camera'], origin=...) plus browser launched with --use-fake-device-for-media-stream (auto in this env). Camera overlay is portaled to <body> — assert parent.tagName === 'BODY'. Upload multipart request Content-Length is not exposed in Playwright request.headers (returns -1); rely on backend enforcement for size check. Purged inspection to reuse: photos_purged_at != null (found via loop over GET /api/inspections + GET /api/inspections/{id}); testid photos-purged-notice on detail page. Detail tables use testids defect-table + all-items-table with rows testid `<tbl>-row-<item_id>` and no toggle button.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 33 backend + all specified frontend behaviours verified. One test-only fix applied: mongosh backdate query changed from {id: '<uuid>'} to {_id: ObjectId('<id>')} because inspections are stored with Mongo ObjectId, not a string 'id' field.
